subject: Biology
title: Sexual Reproduction in Flowering Plants - DPP 05 (Outbreeding Devices & Pollination Types)

questions.question: Which of the following plants produce(s) chasmogamous and cleistogamous flowers?
Transfer of pollen grains from anther to the stigma of another flower of same plant is:
Geitonogamy is-
options: Functionally cross pollination involving a pollinating agent
Genetically it is similar to autogamy since the pollen grains come from the same plant
questions.explanation: Option (D) is correct: Both and are correct.

questions.question: The given figure shows the plant of Commelina with two types of flowers (F and F ). The flowers are–
questions.explanation: Option (C) is correct: F - Chasmogamous, F - Cleistogamous.

questions.question: Which of the following statements is correct?
options: Majority of plants use biotic agents for pollination
Pollination by wind is more common among abiotic pollinations
Pollination by water is quite rare in flowering plants

questions.question: Assertion: Geitonogamy is genetically similar to autogamy. Reason: The pollen grains come from same plant.
options: If both Assertion and Reason are true and Reason is the correct explanation of Assertion.
If both Assertion and Reason are true but Reason is not the correct explanation of Assertion.
Assertion is true but Reason is false.
Assertion is false but Reason is true.
questions.explanation: Option (A) is correct: If both Assertion and Reason are true and Reason is the correct explanation of Assertion..

questions.question: Given below are two statements: Statement-I: Cleistogamous flowers are invariably autogamous. Statement-II: Cleistogamy is disadvantageous as there is no chance for cross pollination. In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below:
options: Statement-I is incorrect but Statement-II is correct
Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct
Both Statement-I and Statement-II are incorrect
Statement-I is correct but Statement-II is incorrect
questions.explanation: Option (B) is correct: Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct.

questions.question: Well exposed stamen and feathery stigma is feature of:
